sources.title: A comprehensive study of Convergent and Commutative Replicated Data Types
sources.snippet: Defines state-based CRDTs and proves that a join-semilattice with a monotonic update function converges.

sources.title: Delta State Replicated Data Types
sources.snippet: Shows delta-state CRDTs reduce the message size that full state-based propagation requires.

sources.title: Redis documentation
sources.snippet: Describes Redis's active-active geo-distribution built on conflict-free replicated data types.

sources.title: CRDTs in production systems
sources.snippet: Reports several teams adopting CRDTs for collaborative editing, and notes that memory overhead is the most common complaint.
